scoring_justification: Recompute Pearson correlation between delta_E_eV and avg_bond_angle_deg from agent CSV; verify per-site physical constraints (energy range, charge increase, volume). Barrier compared to threshold with monotonic reward.

hidden_assets.purpose: Defect energy range, volume constraint, charge increase, correlation threshold, barrier threshold.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported values (Table I, Fig. 2, text). Extended tolerance to cover toolchain spread.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from paper reported ranges with generous margins.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are anchored to the paper's reported results; serve as hidden constraints to judge reproduction fidelity.

outputs.description: Per-site H-flip defect properties that will be checked against physical constraints and correlations (e.g., energy in expected range, effective charge increase, volume expansion, negative correlation between energy and bond angle).
Energy barrier for H-flip transition at a single representative site, validated against a minimum threshold.

output_contract.notes: The checker will verify that per-site properties fall within physically plausible ranges, that effective charges increase upon flipping, that volume changes are small and positive, that barrier exceeds a threshold, and that a negative correlation exists between defect energy and bond angle. The exact target values and tolerances are hidden.
